comment: The most findings of each kind the screenshot harness may report before the build fails. Lower a number whenever a change earns it; raising one is a decision that belongs in a review, not a commit message. Measured over the full page set, including the create-exercise/routine/plan/workout flows. smallTapTargets went 3 -> 1 when the tag chip became its own remove button, and 1 -> 0 when the @mention links under a workout got a width floor to go with the height floor they already had. Every number here is zero now, which is the only comfortable place for them to be.
